page.layout: One printed page. Top: a title block, full width, centred, with the page number "I" at the top right. Below: one column of running text beside a woodcut initial "E" at the left, with a catchline-like mark after "anatomen" and "quatuor" that is not text. The "A" signature sits at the foot, centred.

main_text.l: Sequitur ut agamus de membris Ec-
primat, ut in Ecclesiâ infimum lo-
cum ei post quosvis Clericos adscri-
bat contra verbum Dei, cujus nos
stione præcedente à nobis factum est.

page.notes: The woodcut initial E is joined to "Gimus" as "EGimus". Long s is written as plain s throughout. The small marks along the right edge and the short underline-like strokes after "anatomen", "membrum" and "quatuor" are ink specks or printing marks, not text. Spelling "Conciliis" follows the rule for i/j. The circumflex on "râ" and the macron on "librorū" are as printed as far as I can see.
